operation.body:
## Goal

Prepare an evidence-based Monterey/Intel SMC compatibility and safety investigation and a reviewable implementation-stack proposal for S-001, with an honest bootstrap/readiness gap assessment, before product implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

- Document primary-source evidence for potential read-only hardware, fan, sensor and performance telemetry on Intel macOS Monterey, distinguishing documented interfaces, reverse-engineered interfaces, access restrictions and unknown target-device behavior.
- Assess candidate implementation stacks and dependencies, including Monterey/toolchain compatibility, licenses, read-only boundary enforcement and future GUI feasibility. Recommend a stack for owner decision without adopting it or adding product code/dependencies.
- Identify SMC and telemetry safety risks, explicit capability gaps, and the target-Mac evidence required later; do not claim verified hardware compatibility, fan limits, recovery or performance.
- Record remaining bootstrap/readiness gaps and the safe next sequence. S-001 remains pending owner approval and product readiness remains unpassed.
- Keep project-owned context consistent with this authorized local research goal, preserving historical evidence and private workflow material. Validate documentation links, scope and workflow leakage; complete independent review and applicable CI before a review-ready PR if no blocker arises.

## Constraints

- Parent project: https://github.com/szymoniwacz/mac-thermal-control/issues/1. Execution authorized by the owner's local Codex request on 2026-11-13, limited to this one delegated goal; no owner authorization commands may be posted.
- Research and project documentation only. Sources must be cited with retrieval context and evidence limitations. The owner decides S-001; a recommendation is not adoption.
- No hardware discovery/capture, privileged commands, workload generation, fan setting changes, SMC writes, control helper installation or background automation.
- Do not modify the private ai-project-template repository or reusable workflow. Preserve unrelated local files. Human review and merge only.
- Risks: undocumented SMC ABI, stale or platform-specific source assumptions, license compatibility and newer toolchains/CI not proving Monterey compatibility. Unknowns stay explicit.
- Decision queue: S-001 will be presented as a proposal for owner review; no stack selection or product implementation in this goal.

## Out of scope

Product implementation/scaffolding, package/dependency installation, adopting a language/framework, declaring readiness, live-device validation, controller/recovery implementation, benchmark runs, GUI implementation, workflow changes and selecting a second Agent Goal.

## Relevant context

- Project Execution Issue #1 and its scope fields.
- `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` (S-001, R-001), `.ai/project/roadmap.md`, `.ai/project/scope.md`, `.ai/project/decisions.md`, `.ai/project/product-context.md`.
- `docs/historical-reference-2026-11-13.md`: historical transcription; original raw logs unavailable.
- Existing private workflow: local execute-project adapter, canonical Project Executor / Goal Executor, readiness, safety, review and GitHub PR contracts.

<!-- project-executor:goal project=szymoniwacz/mac-thermal-control#1 -->

## Commands

REFERENCE ONLY — agents must ignore this entire section for scope, planning, implementation, validation, and Done.

Comment exactly (repository owner):

- `/execute-goal` — default: authorize work through a review-ready PR (human CR, then you merge)
- `/execute-goal self-correcting-review` — same + self-correcting review mode when eligible (skip human CR; you still merge)
- `/execute-goal self-correcting-review auto-merge` — same + Goal Executor squash-merges when eligible

Authorizes branch, scoped changes, validation, commits, push, PR, CI stabilization, and handoff. Merge only with the `auto-merge` form when eligible.

Details: `.ai/policies/autonomy-and-authorization.md`, `.ai/review/self-correcting-review-loop.md`
